articles.title: Anchorage backs Treasury’s GENIUS AML rules, seeks secondary-market sanctions clarity
articles.snippet: A public comment letter argues that regulated stablecoin issuers need clearer compliance standards to avoid sanctions risks tied to secondary-market activity.

articles.title: Hyperliquid, Paradigm urge revision of GENIUS money-laundering rule
articles.snippet: The Hyperliquid Policy Center and Paradigm say the Treasury’s money-laundering rules for the GENIUS Act are too onerous for stablecoin issuers.

articles.title: Paradigm, Hyperliquid Policy Center Push Back on GENIUS Act Stablecoin AML Rule
articles.snippet: The groups say issuers, DeFi apps, and validators need clearer limits on who is responsible once stablecoins change hands.
